title: feat(record-page): on a wide full page the details are pinned left beside the record's tabs; the right summary rail is retired (#35890)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
Fixes #35890

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuSuWjKV41568rAPVdLLNa2U)_

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUZTwDqtEFzNFCVTri

Part of epic #35590 (record page redo). One PR for the card.

Clause-②: yes (widening): `RecordPageColumns` (exported from `@object-ui/plugin-detail`) gains the optional props `fullPage`, `detailsWidth`, `onDetailsWidthChange` and `onShownTabChange`, and `onEnlargeRelated` an optional second argument `{ replace?: boolean }`. `rightColumn` and `rail` stay on the props as `@deprecated` no-ops, so no caller breaks. New exports: `RECORD_PAGE_DETAILS_WIDTH`, `RECORD_PAGE_PIN_MIN_WIDTH`, `recordPagePinsDetails`; `recordPageTierHasRightColumn` stays exported and is now `@deprecated`. `@object-ui/i18n`: two new keys in every pack (`detail.approvalPendingStep`, `detail.detailsColumnResize`), and `detail.recordTabOverview` changes its text (概览 / Overview → 详情 / Details); every key the retired rail read stays in every pack, unread. The `RecordSummaryRail` module was internal (never exported from the package entry) and is deleted.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 记录整页够宽时（放得下左 320 + 间隔 24 + 右 400），字段固定在左栏，其他页签（子表、附件、审批、动态）在右边，默认打开第一个；左栏默认 400，空间紧时自动让到 320，可以拖动，宽度按对象记在浏览器里。
- 右侧摘要栏（审批 / 附件 / 最近动态 / 其他相关卡片）在所有宽度都去掉了，⊟ 按钮和 ⌘⇧, 快捷键一起去掉；第一个页签改名「详情」。
- 「审批中」标签在有当前步骤时显示「审批中 · 当前步骤」（审批人自己仍是「待你审批」）。
- 抽屉、手机、窄窗口不分栏，照旧是一栏页签；它们也会看到两处变化：右侧摘要栏没了，第一个页签叫「详情」。手写的记录页不受影响；字段里放了子表的页面（#35889）不分栏。
- 隐藏了的子表仍能从「更多」或带 `?related=` 的链接打开。
- 实测：1440 宽、左侧导航展开、评论栏打开时，内容只有 708，不够 744，页面退回一栏页签（打开的页签保持不变）。1280 和 1366 评论栏打开仍分栏。Sales 已接受这个代价，收起导航即恢复三栏（#35890 note 7069882604）。等 #36112 改成 1280 起默认展开导航后，1280 和 1366 展开导航再打开评论栏也会退回页签，收起导航即恢复三栏。

## What changes

**When the page pins.** Ruling on the card ([comment 7064066204](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/35890#issuecomment-7064066204), option 0 of the reviewed decision card): a full page pins its details when its content fits **left 320 + gap 24 + right 400** (744 content px). The left column is 400 px (or the reader's dragged width) and narrows by itself to 320 px to leave the tabs 400 px; narrower than that, the page falls back to the tab row. This replaces the card's line 「沿用出现右栏的宽度」. Pinning is measured on the page content's own width (`clientWidth`, ResizeObserver), never on the window, so the comment panel of #36075, which gives way at window widths of 1280 and up, narrows the page and the page re-decides by itself.

What that means on common windows, **measured** in the console against the CRM example (`measure-l1c.json`; the page frame is the window minus the nav minus the host's 48 px margin, and the content is the frame minus its 48 px padding; at 1280 and 1366 the nav is collapsed, at 1440 it is open at 256 px; comment panel 380 px, `beside`):

| Window | Frame, panel closed | Panel closed | Frame, panel open | Panel open |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1280 | 1232 | pinned, details 400 / tabs 760 | 852 | pinned, details 380 / tabs 400 |
| 1366 | 1318 | pinned, details 400 / tabs 846 | 938 | pinned, details 400 / tabs 466 |
| 1440 | 1136 | pinned, details 400 / tabs 664 | 756 (content 708) | **not pinned**: the tab row, with 「详情」 first and the shown list kept |

The earlier 1440 row (record area 1184, tabs 412) assumed no host margin; the measured frame is 48 px narrower, so with the nav open and the panel open the content is 708, under 744, and the page uses the tab row. Windows of about 1416 to 1475 with the nav open and the panel open land here. This follows the ruled threshold as written, and Sales accepted it: with the sidebar expanded, opening the comment panel can return the fields to the tab row, and collapsing the sidebar restores three columns ([note 7069882604](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/35890#issuecomment-7069882604), with #36112 F1). These windows hold for today's sidebar threshold (expanded from 1416). Once #36112 PR B makes the sidebar start expanded from 1280 (ruling 7069868269), the band with the sidebar expanded becomes about 1280 to 1475, so 1280 and 1366 also go to the tab row when the panel opens; collapsing the sidebar still restores three columns. The 1416 comment in `recordPageColumns.ts` is updated by #36112 PR B.

**Layout, pinned.** `[details 320–400+ px] [24 px separator] [tabs minmax(0,1fr)]`. The details render at one field column (`DetailsColumnCapContext` = 1). The tab row moves into the right column and drops 「详情」; the open tab is the address's `?related=` when it names one, otherwise the first tab (implied, never written). Each column scrolls on its own when the page has a scroll parent with room (`usePinnedHeight`). Esc does not close a tab while pinned (there is no "back to details" to go to).

**The separator.** `role="separator"`, `aria-orientation="vertical"`, `aria-valuenow/min/max`; pointer drag previews and commits on release; ←/→ move 16 px, Home/End go to the ends. The width is the `record.columns.details-width` workspace preference (per object, `{ width, v: 1 }`), which replaces the retired `record.columns.related` (⊟) preference.

**Narrowing out.** When a pinned page narrows below the threshold on the same record and the address names no tab, the implied tab is written to the address with `replace`, so the reader stays on what they were looking at and Back history does not grow.

**Not pinned.** A page with no other tab draws the details alone, with no tab row. A page whose details hold a related table among the fields (#35889) does not pin. Drawer, split pane and phone (`fullPage` false or too narrow) keep the one-column tab row and never pin. What reaches them: the rail is gone there too, and the first tab reads 「详情」. Measured: drawer at 1440 (details 622 across, 「详情」 shown) and phone at 375 (details 327 across, 「详情」 shown), both with no rail.

**Rail retired.** `RecordSummaryRail` is deleted with the ⊟ panel toggle, its `⌘⇧,` shortcut and the `record.columns.related` preference; the attachment-count hook and approval-pending test move to `recordTabBadges.ts`. The `PanelToggles` plumbing stays (empty) for #36075. The hidden-list foot line under the rail goes too; hidden lists and the reset are in the tab row's 「更多」 menu. The "default order changed" hint stays, under the tab row. A hidden list still opens, from its 「更多」 item or from `?related=` naming it (`requested` accepts ids in `resolved.hidden`; test red without the fix).

**Other card items.** The overview tab is labelled 「详情」 in every locale (`detail.recordTabOverview` takes the `detail.details` word). The in-approval tag reads `In approval · {{step}}` (`detail.approvalPendingStep`, 11 locales) for non-approvers when the request names a step, using the approvals panel's own `stepDisplayText`.

**Host.** `RecordDetailView` passes `fullPage={!embedded}`, the width preference and `onShownTabChange`. When the shown tab is the 动态 timeline (implied or chosen), the full activity window is read, as it was when the tab was chosen. Feed reads at open are unchanged (the page payload still asks discussion + activity top 5 for the tab's count), to stay out of #36075's way. Merged with `main` after #36114 and #36178 (the comment panel, PRs 1 and 2), keeping both sides: the rail's 最近动态 card that #36114's `RecordCommentsInPanelContext` note spoke of no longer exists. `overlap-check.mjs` at push (`241f4b21`): clean against `main`, #36187, #36123 and #35923; it conflicts with #36183 (#36047 slice 2, the text-size sweep) in `RecordSummaryRail.tsx` (deleted here), the e2e spec (renamed here) and two plugin-detail tests. Whichever lands second resolves it; #36183 re-runs its mapping script on `main`.

**Docs.** `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx` (Record pages › The synthesized default) now describes the tab row, the pinned layout and when related rows are read, instead of the right column.

## Acceptance notes (card checklist)

- Wide full page: fields left, other tabs right, first of them open. ✔ (`RecordPageColumns.test.tsx` pinned block; `recordPageTiers-26678` at 1440 / 1100 / 800 px)
- No other tab: fields fill the page, no tab row. ✔
- Right summary cards removed at all widths. ✔ (every tier asserts no `[data-record-summary-card]`)
- Left column 400, draggable, remembered per person per object. ✔ (keyboard + pointer tests; host test writes and re-reads the preference). Kept in the browser's workspace preference store, like the other record-page preferences.
- First tab 「详情」. ✔
- 「审批中 · 当前步骤」. ✔ (`approvalDeclaredActions` test, machine name and label)
- Body-table page does not pin. ✔
- Narrowing keeps the tab (URL replace). ✔ (measured: 1440 with the panel opened wrote `?related=crm_activity.account`)
- A hidden list opens from 「更多」 and from `?related=`. ✔ (`readerArrangement-35595`, red without the fix)
- Drawer / phone never pin and keep the one-column tab row; what reaches them is the rail's removal and the 「详情」 name. Hand-written pages untouched. ✔
- Deliberate drops: the ⊟ control and `⌘⇧,`; the hidden-list foot line (its job is in 「更多」); the rail's three-row previews of each related list (a list now reads its rows when its tab opens).

## Why

Sales asked for the record page they remembered: on a wide full page, the main form on the left and the child tables in tabs on the right (#35890, under epic #35590). The width rule was put to Sales after a decision review because the card's 760 px reading and the 1120 px reading both broke the comment panel layout on common laptops; option 0 keeps three columns (fields | tabs | comments) on every common laptop, which is the figure Sales approved on #36075.

## Verification

- Local, on the merged head `079c7723` (shared box, under `os-verify-lock`): plugin-detail, i18n, app-shell Record*, recordCommentsPanel, relatedListConditions and workspacePreference: 647 files / 6,742 tests pass; app-shell type-check (src and tests) clean. On `241f4b21`: plugin-detail + i18n 509 files / 5,677 tests pass, both type-checks clean, `record-tabs-35595.spec.ts` 6/6 locally. Earlier, on `fbe6e33d`: `vitest run packages/plugin-detail packages/i18n`: 500 files / 5,598 tests pass (31 skipped, existing). `vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/Record packages/app-shell/src/utils/workspacePreference`: 133 files / 1,005 tests pass. The whole app-shell suite did not fit the 28-minute local window; CI is the full reading.
- `type-check` (src and tests) clean for plugin-detail, i18n and app-shell; ESLint `--quiet` on every changed file: 0 errors; `check:test-source-alias` OK.
- Rewritten / converted tests: `RecordPageColumns.test.tsx` (new pinned describe: threshold 744, auto-narrow 824→400 / 800→376 / 744→320 / 743→not pinned, drag, keyboard, drawer never pins, body table, narrowing writes the implied tab with replace, `onShownTabChange`), `RecordDetailView.recordPageTiers-26678` (host at 1440 / 1100 / 800 / 720 / 390, embedded, `?related=timeline` pinned and not, width preference round-trip), `workspacePreference.test.ts` (details-width codec). Deleted with the code they pinned: `RecordPageColumns.switches-27052`, `RecordDetailView.panelToggles-27052`.
- Tests that read the rail now open the 动态 tab or assert its absence: `recordOpenWaves-13010`, `recordOpenOneRequest-28470`, `timelineCount-28737`, `harness › relatedCountsFirst-27056`, `accessibleNames-12625`, `topBar-27524`, `phoneFace-27058`, `feedLoadFailure-29188`.
- Screenshots (1280 / 1440 / 1920, light and dark, with and without other tabs) are attached in the project thread, plus the comment panel open at 1280 / 1366 / 1440, the drawer at 1440 and the phone at 375; the measured numbers are in the evidence comment.
- e2e: `ui/e2e/record-tabs-35595.spec.ts` (renamed from `record-tabs-rail-35595.spec.ts`).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No `packages/spec` change.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (changed files, `--quiet`).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset (`.changeset/35890-record-details-pinned.md`), and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block is the maintainer's summary, in the maintainer's language).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
